data.name: Deluxe Snorkel & Dolphin Watch
data.headline: Most Popular! • All Ages • 4.5 Hours
data.description: Join us on the Kanoa II for a Deluxe Morning Snorkel and Dolphin Watch. Snorkel at Red Hill, a marine sanctuary home to over 600 species of ocean wildlife. Enjoy breakfast and BBQ lunch onboard, with an excellent chance of spotting dolphins. All snorkel gear and flotation devices are provided, along with a fun introduction lesson for beginners.

highlight_box.title: Comfort & Adventure
highlight_box.description: Explore the Kona Coast in style and luxury. Food, three bathrooms, a bar, and the best crew in Kona.

data.cancellation_summary: Full refund with appropriate notice based on group size; no refund for late arrivals
data.cancellation_notes: To receive a full refund, cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance for parties of 9 or fewer, 72 hours for parties of 10–19, and 7 days for parties of 20 or more. Full refunds are provided only in the event of an operator cancellation. Please note that refunds are not available for late arrivals or motion sickness, as sea conditions and individual reactions are beyond our control.
data.booking_notes:
#Mahalo for booking with Body Glove Cruises

We look forward to welcoming you for your Deluxe Morning Snorkel & Dolphin Watch!

Free parking is available at our retail shop in Ilima Court Shopping Center. The address is 75-5629 Kuakini Highway, Kailua Kona, HI 96740. It's about a 5-7 minute walk down to the pier. Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure.

##Discover unique, locally made treasures in our gift shop [The Boatique](https://www.instagram.com/theboatiquehi/)—show this email for 10% off your purchase!

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/cGKvVAYQeO8QiavAeq1K)
***

#Boat Information:

- This tour takes place on the [KANOA II](https://www.bodyglovehawaii.com/our-boat), our 65 ft. Luxury Catamaran.
- Please note that our vessel is a **SMOKE FREE** vessel.
- Take a moment to familiarize yourself with our [safety briefing](https://www.bodyglovehawaii.com/safety).


#Included On This Trip:

- Breakfast, lunch, sodas, juices and snacks
- Snorkel gear, instruction and flotation toys
- Alcoholic beverages are available for purchase from our Premium Bar 
Proudly serving locally made rum, vodka, whiskey, and beer
- Plenty of shade, fresh water showers, and restrooms
- 20 foot water slide & 15 foot high dive platform
- Double wide swim steps
- Excellent chance of dolphin or other marine mammal sightings

Just bring a towel and a smile!

#Special Dietary Requests:
For gluten-free, vegetarian, or vegan meals, please call 800.551.8911 at least **48 hours** before your adventure.
